response.justification: While the candidate has extensive software engineering experience, particularly in full-stack web development and microservices, he lacks almost all of the critical qualifications for this role. He does not possess the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated experience with Linux kernel modifications or embedded UNIX C programming, and lacks background in L2/L3 networking and embedded security protocols.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across various domains and tech stacks.
Strong background in system architecture, microservices, and DevOps infrastructure.
Demonstrated leadership, community involvement, and mentoring abilities through workshops and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks the required native-level Japanese language proficiency.
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel investigation, source-code modification, or embedded UNIX C programming.
Missing required domain knowledge in L2/L3 networking and specific security technologies like MACsec and IEEE 802.1X.
